subject: Pilot paused — procurement routing delay; interim sandbox credits?
messages:
From: Samir Gupta <samir@helixlabs.com>
To: David Kim <david.kim@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: procurement@helixlabs.com
Date: 2027-05-30T17:12:00-07:00
Subject: Pilot paused — PO routing delay, can you keep the sandbox alive?

Hi David,

Quick note from procurement: our PO is in a routing queue because the VP of Finance is out until next week. Were very close to sign-off but the pilot environment is set to expire tomorrow and that will interrupt a couple of sensitive tests the engineering team planned.

Is there scope for Redwood to keep our sandbox active for another 10 days while the PO clears? If not, would you consider a small interim credit to avoid us losing momentum? I attached a short purchase intent document and the draft PO the legal team circulated.

(attachment: Purchase_Intention.pdf, pdf)
(attachment: HLX_PO_Draft.pdf, pdf)

Appreciate any help here — were excited about the throughput numbers were seeing.

Thanks,
Samir
Samir Gupta
Head of Platform Engineering | Helix Labs
From: David Kim <david.kim@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samir Gupta <samir@helixlabs.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-05-30T18:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot paused — PO routing delay, can you keep the sandbox alive?

Hi Samir — thanks for the context and the attachments. 

Short answer: yes, we can keep the pilot live while the PO clears. I can provision a short interim sprint credit to cover the next 7 days so your tests dont get interrupted. Before I do that, I need a brief internal sign-off because this is outside standard trial policy. If you can confirm the expected PO clearance date and re-send the HLX_PO_Draft with the project code visible (that helps our finance team), Ill escalate for approval now.

If the PO looks like it might take longer than 10 days, tell me and well set up a staggered credit (7 days now, + extension if PO is still pending).

Im looping in Marissa and Ben to approve the small credit and to ensure its tracked correctly in HubSpot.

Best,
David Kim
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
(attachment referenced: credit-approval-note.txt)
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: David Kim <david.kim@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Samir Gupta <samir@helixlabs.com>
Date: 2027-05-30T19:10:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot paused — PO routing delay, can you keep the sandbox alive?

Thanks for the tag, David.

Given the deal health (HLX-2027-053) and the fact procurement has provided a PO draft, approve a one-time 7-day interim sandbox credit to preserve their test window. Please:
- Apply credit effective immediately and confirm quota applied to Helix Labs account.
- Log a HubSpot activity: "Interim credit applied — procurement routing delay" and attach the PO draft.
- Add a follow-up task for finance to reconcile once the PO comes in.

Ben/Neha: if finance flags anything unusual, escalate to me.

Marissa Cole
Director, Sales Operations | Redwood Inference
From: Samir Gupta <samir@helixlabs.com>
To: David Kim <david.kim@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-05-31T09:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot paused — PO routing delay, can you keep the sandbox alive?

David / Marissa,

Huge thanks — we really appreciate the fast response. Our procurement lead says the PO should clear within 9-10 business days but Ill push to shorten that. Ive re-attached the HLX_PO_Draft with the project code in the header per your request.

(attachment: HLX_PO_Draft.pdf, pdf)

Ill confirm if we need an extra extension, but seven days buys us enough runway to keep momentum. Ill also share the HubSpot contact for our finance approver if that helps speed reconciliation.

—Samir
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: David Kim <david.kim@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Samir Gupta <samir@helixlabs.com>
Date: 2027-06-01T10:20:00-07:00
Subject: Interim credit applied — HLX (7 days)

All — quick status. Ive applied a 7-day sandbox credit to Helix Labs (deal HLX-2027-053).
Actions completed:
- Credit active: 2027-05-30 through 2027-06-06 (7 days)
- HubSpot activity created: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/HLX-2027-053 (activity ID 8792)
- DocuSign envelope for PO routed: https://www.docusign.com/helixtap?envelopeId=12345

Neha: please monitor the PO arrival and reconcile the credit once the invoice/PO posts. Marissa: flag me if we should extend the credit beyond the initial window.

Ben Carter
Senior Sales Manager | Redwood Inference
